violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM MUST BE ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED COOKING OIL STORED DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS FOR FOOD STORAGE.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system: MOP SINK FAUCET WITH HOSE ATTACHED WITH SPRAY NOZZLE AT END.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE EITHER DISCONNECT SPRAY NOZZLE AFTER USE OR INSTALL APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. PIC DISCONNECTED HOSE DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lockers, In Designated Room/Area
violations.observation: Observed that lockers and personal storage facilities are not located to protect food, equipment, linens, and/or single-service items from contamination. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE TOOTHBRUSH AND TOOTHPASTE STORED ON PREP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate lockers and personal storage facilities to prevent the potential contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, linens, or single-service items. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE DESIGNATED SPACE FOR STORAGE OF EMPLOYEE PERSONAL ITEMS AWAY FROM FOOD PREPARATION AND SERVICE AREA. PIC REMOVED ITEMS FROM KITCHEN.
